_readme: Drop artwork in this folder and list it here. Anything listed replaces the
code-drawn vector figures — the game prefers images whenever this file has
entries, and falls back to the vectors when it is empty.
square         the tile grid is square, so a non-square image gets
centre-cropped to a square and you lose the edges
>= 1200px      a 4x4 grid on a retina phone shows roughly 300 device px
per tile, so 1200 is the floor and 2048 is comfortable.
full bleed     a background that reaches every edge is BETTER than a cut
out silhouette: every tile then carries image, so no piece
is blank and the puzzle has no free squares
bold + clear   the picture is cut into 9 or 16 pieces and some arrive
mirrored. Strong shapes and clear light direction make a
wrong piece obvious. Busy, low-contrast or symmetrical
.png or .webp  webp is roughly a quarter the size for the same quality;
png is fine and lossless. Both are loaded the same way
Files beginning with an underscore are the built-in test images.
